title: Entity optimization
content: Entity optimization means using the same names and descriptions for a company and its products across its site, its profiles, and its markup so systems can treat them as one entity.

meta.why: Consistent names and descriptions help a system connect a company's site with its profiles and distinguish the company from others with similar names.
meta.example: A company uses one legal name, one product name, and one short description on its site, its LinkedIn page, and its Organization markup.
meta.check: Compare the company name, product names, and description on your site with your official profiles and your Organization markup, then correct the mismatches.
meta.limitation: Consistent naming does not guarantee a knowledge panel, and an AI answer can still describe the company in its own words.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: Organization structured data | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/organization | Platform documentation
